texts.preamble: Karnik Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 22 January, 2020 Author: Vivek Rusia Bench: Vivek Rusia
texts.arguments: Shri Vikas Yadav, learned Govt. Advocate for the respondent/ After arguing learned counsel for the applicant admits that application under Section 78 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 has been filed before the evidence came on record. Section 78 of the Act is reproduced below :- 78. Power of court to implead manufacturer etc. "Where at any time during the trial of any offence under this Act alleged to have been committed by any person, not being the importer, manufacturer, distributor or dealer of any article of food, the court, is satisfied, on the evidence adduced before it, that such importer, manufacturer, distributor or dealer is also concerned with that offence, then the court may, notwithstanding anything contained in sub-section (3) of section 319 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (2 of 1974), or in section 71 of this Act, proceed against him as though a prosecution has been instituted under this Act."
texts.petitioner_arguments: Shri Vikas Yadav, learned Govt. Advocate for the respondent/ After arguing learned counsel for the applicant admits that application under Section 78 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 has been filed before the evidence came on record.
